# TeX Live packages required to build the resume (installed by
# TeX-Live/setup-texlive-action via .github/workflows/*.yml).
# scheme-basic provides latex, lualatex, and core LaTeX tooling
# (latex, graphics, tools, hyperref, geometry, luaotfload, lm).
scheme-basic
# Loaded by components/commonheader.sty and their transitive deps not
# covered by scheme-basic (verified against texlive.tlpdb):
enumitem
import
titlesec
xcolor
# Fonts and icons
fontawesome5        # pulls luatexbase + ctablestack on LuaLaTeX
fontspec            # pulls euenc, xunicode, tipa
pgf                 # twemojis requires tikz; pgf pulls xcolor + fp
twemojis
# Emoji support (requires the TwemojiMozilla font at build time,

emoji
